metadata.scope: The data states the ret mind map's behaviours need. Orders and undecided returns are SCENARIO: seeded per run with dates relative to the run, because the return window expires on its own and every decision consumes the line (FIFTH RULE q1 + q2).
metadata.how_to_run: Right before every returns run: `npm run seed:returns && npm run seed:returns:decisions` (both self-heal: an aged or consumed fixture is rebuilt with dates relative to that moment), or `/qa-seed-data --profile <id>` for one behaviour.
metadata.known_limit: Per-case (STEP) order creation needs a runner primitive for run-relative dates and unique values (the same blocker as 050d PRF-GQL-039/040); until it exists the run is the unit of freshness.
